Use case: stylized-concept. NEW ORIGINAL KFB SLOP CHARACTER FAMILY, not an edit or continuation of any generated sheet. Produce ONE landscape 1536x1024 true transparent PNG sheet, EXACTLY SIX complete standalone characters, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Input image1 is ORIGINAL ink-family morphology/material reference; image2 is ORIGINAL occupational accessory craft reference. They are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets: invent the new subjects below. Never copy their repetitive angry expressions or all-red eyeballs.

Every character is ONE WHOLE CONTINUOUS FOOTLESS dark charcoal/deep violet INK BLOB/SPLAT, thick softly rounded asymmetrical goo lobes, modeled lips and lids, irregular ivory teeth, a few detached droplets. UPRIGHT to camera, full dominant goo body visible below partial collar/accessories. No human torso, legs, feet, severed bust, lying body, cloth-shaped body or furry spikes. WHITE/IVORY SCLERA surrounding distinct RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL in EVERY visible eye. Soft handmade plasticine volumes, fingerprints, subtle violet sheen, warm upper-left studio light, exquisite rounded clay metal/wood/glass/fabric props. Offbeat grotesque cartoon charm, not cute Pixar mascot faces, angular/gritty clay or flat purple patches.

Six expressive peak moments. Different silhouette, mouth tension, lids, gaze and body attitude BEFORE outfit; never six hat-swaps or repeated V-brow grins. Exactly TWO female-read characters in specified cells, conveyed through styling and acting within the same ink species. All mature adults. Satire of petty certainty, institutional rituals and interrupted dignity, affectionate and absurd. Just ONE or TWO bold beautifully made props per actor, held at own body with immediate physical comedy; no complex conceptual contraptions. No floating emotion symbols. NO circular O-mouths or protruding tongues; vary crooked closed smile, flat sag, clenched grin, uneven open laugh and underbite instead.

Strict separated cells with generous empty transparent gutters and safe margins around entire silhouette, props and droplets, each fits comfortably within its own cell. Comparable visual scale without identical proportions. No overlap/touching, no shared objects, no reaching to neighbors. TRUE transparent alpha in all empty spaces and holes; NO background/gradient, scenelet, scenery, floor, shadow disc, painted checkerboard, text/numbers/labels/logos/captions/borders. Occupational/historical/retro-future context through props only.

FRESH SUBJECT FAMILY: EVERYDAY_SERVICES_12_2026-11-04; sheet domestic-everyday.
TOP LEFT slot1 male BUILDING CARETAKER: tall wide-bottom pear blob, soft moss peaked cap with plain brass roundel, tiny mustard work collar. Indignant jagged open-tooth ROAR with uneven teeth, one white eye bulging and other narrowed, no tongue. Grips ONE chunky brass key ring bearing THREE broad simple keys, one absurdly huge old iron key held upright; own goo fist barely contains ring. No doors or background.
TOP MIDDLE slot2 FEMALE-READ HOUSEPLANT NEIGHBOR: very low wide wavy ink splat, purple soft bun with two coral curlers and short teal housecoat collar. Loving but suspicious CLOSED sideways fang smile, one heavy lid and one raised, red gaze down. Both arms hug ONE little chunky terracotta pot containing a SINGLE tall bent fleshy green stem with three broad rounded leaves drooping protectively around the pot. No gardening scene, huge leafy clutter or text.
TOP RIGHT slot3 male HOBBY RADIO LISTENER: compact spherical ink blob with one long sideways curling crown lobe, tiny cream knitted collar and worn indigo soft cap. Enormous white eyes unevenly wide staring sideways, pinched crooked UNDERBITE with two lower teeth, no round mouth. Holds ONE fat faded coral retro portable radio tightly to own ear, brass tuning knob in free hand; short thick bent antenna wholly within cell, blank dark speaker grille, no writing/UI.
BOTTOM LEFT slot4 male SLEEP-DEPRIVED NIGHT-SHIFT NEIGHBOR: towering narrow slumped ink bean, faded teal pajama collar and small burgundy nightcap. Eyes almost closed with visible white/red/black slivers, profound downward FLAT pout with single broad ivory tooth, not smiling. Clutches ONE enormous rounded brass twin-bell alarm clock against own goo body like a shield, one hand covering its bells; blank ivory dial/no numerals. UPRIGHT whole ink base, no bed or lying figure.
BOTTOM MIDDLE slot5 FEMALE-READ CLUB TREASURER: medium tall rounded triangular splat, short mustard tied neckscarf, one soft violet quiff and little brass pince-nez. Tight crooked CLOSED gold-fang smile, one lazy eye down and other narrowed sideways. Cradles ONE comically tiny tarnished copper trophy cup in one giant goo hand, opposite arm hugs a fat worn indigo ledger with plain cover. Membership dignity, no symbols/letters.
BOTTOM RIGHT slot6 male PARCEL-OBSESSED NEIGHBOR: broad compact asymmetrical ink splat with three low crown nubs, faded plum cardigan collar. ECSTATIC uneven SIDEWAYS toothy laugh, one wide eye and other delighted squint, no tongue. Both goo arms hug ONE dented cream cardboard parcel with broad rust-red string cross and one blank little tag; cheek presses possessively to box. Full goo body below box, no human torso or scene.
IMPORTANT SPACING REFINEMENT: Each actor PLUS ALL props and droplets must occupy no more than 85 percent of its own 512x512 cell in either dimension. Aim for at least 32 pixels fully empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides INSIDE EVERY cell. Keep characters equally readable and upright; nothing touches a cell seam or canvas edge.
